sources.title: nazarkozak/whisper-small-disfluent-smoothed-lora · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A LoRA fine-tune of openai/whisper-small that transcribes disfluent / stuttered speech to clean, fluent text — recovering the speaker's intended words and dropping the disfluencies (filled pauses, repetitions, sound prolongations, blocks, interjections). This is the smoothed variant.

sources.title: nazarkozak/whisper-small-disfluent-verbatim-lora · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A LoRA fine-tune of openai/whisper-small that transcribes disfluent / stuttered speech verbatim — preserving filled pauses (uh, um), exact word repetitions, and partial-word fragments rather than smoothing them away.

sources.title: GitHub - Shraban-source/Whisper-LoRA-Speech-Emotion-Recognition: Speech ...
sources.snippet: 🎙️ Whisper-LoRA Speech Emotion Recognition A Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) system built using OpenAI Whisper Small with LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) for parameter-efficient fine-tuning. The model classifies speech into four emotions while also generating speech transcripts using Whisper.

sources.title: ️ Whisper LoRA Fine-Tuning for Speech-to-Text - GitHub
sources.snippet: This project demonstrates efficient fine-tuning of OpenAI's Whisper-small model using LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) for English speech-to-text transcription. It leverages the Common Voice dataset, Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT, and PyTorch to enable memory-efficient training and prompt-guided inference for accurate, customizable ASR performance.

sources.title: Whisper Small — OpenASR Models
sources.snippet: Whisper Small is OpenAI's 244M-parameter multilingual Whisper checkpoint. It uses the standard Whisper encoder-decoder architecture for automatic speech recognition and speech translation, trained with large-scale weak supervision on 680k hours of labelled speech.
